Input: The number of chargers M, all candidate MCSs and their corresponding candidate positions set  \( \Gamma \) , the set of PoIs O, and the objective function  \( P_{addit}(C) \) 

Output: Charger placement set C

3:  \( c^{*} \leftarrow \arg\max_{c \in \Gamma \setminus C}(P_{addit}(C \cup \{c\}) - P_{addit}(C)) \) ;

4:  \( C = C \cup \{c^{*}\} \) ;

5: end while
